Introducing the EVGA X570 FTW WIFI
- Tuesday, November 9, 2021 
The EVGA X570 FTW WIFI is a motherboard built upon the AMD X570 chipset to provide everything you need
while giving you the performance you demand. Designed and engineered from scratch with a 15-phase digital VRM
design, this is one sleek-looking motherboard jam-packed with the latest features and EVGA GUI BIOS. Paired with
an AMD Ryzen™ 5000 Series processor, this board is PCIe Gen4-ready with a data transfer rate of up to 16 GT/s
to support the latest graphics cards and M.2 NVMe SSDs, scorching-fast 4600MHz+(OC) memory,
HDMI/DisplayPort outputs, lots of USB and SATA 6Gb/s ports, and RGB/ARGB options. The EVGA X570 FTW
WIFI gives you the freedom to choose your EVGA motherboard without sacrifice or compromise.
1. 15-Phase Digital VRM 2. AM4 CPU Socket 3. PCIe Gen 4.0 M.2 Key-M Slots 4. PCIe 4.0 x16 (x16/x8, x8) 5. 2x
ARGB / 2x RGB Headers 6. USB BIOS Update Port 7. 4x DDR4 DIMMs 8. Pump Header

To learn more about the EVGA X570 FTW WIFI, visit https://www.evga.com/articles/01510/EVGA-X570-FTW-WIFI
About EVGA
EVGA is the #1 NVIDIA authorized partner in channel sales throughout North America. Based on the philosophy of
intelligent innovation, market knowledge, and the real time operation, EVGA continues to identify the need in the
market place and providing the solution to that need. By offering product differentiation, a 90 day Step-Up program,
and other customer focused programs, EVGA is a clear leader in all categories: etail, retail, distribution, and system
builders. With headquarters in Brea, CA, EVGA's global coverage includes EVGA GmbH in Munich, EVGA LATAM
in Miami, and EVGA Hong Kong. For further information online about EVGA, visit http://www.evga.com.

Highlights:
## EVGA X570 FTW WIFI

...

The EVGA X570 FTW WIFI is a motherboard built upon the AMD X570 
chipset to provide everything you need while giving you the performance you 
demand. Designed and engineered from scratch with a 15-phase digital VRM 
design, this is one sleek-looking motherboard jam-packed with the latest 
features and EVGA GUI BIOS. Paired with an AMD Ryzen™ 5000 Series 
processor, this board is PCIe Gen4-ready with a data transfer rate of up to 16 
GT/s to support the latest graphics cards and M.2 NVMe SSDs, scorching-fast 
4600MHz+(OC) memory, HDMI/DisplayPort outputs, lots of USB and SATA 
6Gb/s ports, and RGB/ARGB options. The EVGA X570 FTW WIFI gives 
you the freedom to choose your EVGA motherboard without sacrifice or 
compromise. 
Furthermore, this board is designed not only for overclockers, but also for 
gamers by being NVIDIA ® SLI ® Ready and featuring two M.2 Key-M slots and 
much more! 
Lastly, a motherboard is only as good as its BIOS, and the EVGA X570 FTW 
WIFI features EVGA’s latest UEFI/BIOS GUI with a focus on overclocking 
and functionality in a lean, straightforward package. You don’t need to be an 
expert to configure your motherboard, but if you are, you’ll find features 
unavailable anywhere else. 
Combining the best of current technology with the latest innovations, EVGA is 
further refining motherboard performance!

...

##### Motherboard Specifications

 Size: 
ATX form-factor of 12 inches x 9.6 inches (305mm x 243.8mm) 
 Microprocessor support: 
AMD AM4 Socket 1331 Processors (Ryzen ™ 5000/5000G/4000G/3000 
Series) 
 Operating Systems: 
Supports Windows 10 64bit, Windows 11 Ready 
 System Memory support: 
Supports up to 128GB Dual channel DDR4 at up to 4600MHz+ (OC). 
 USB 2.0 Ports: 
4x internal from 2 FP headers via AMD ® X570 PCH 
1x from Update Port for flashing the BIOS without CPU 
Supports hot plug/wake-up from S3 mode 
 USB 3.2 Gen.1 Ports: 
6x – 4x external (Type-A) from CPU, 2x internal via 1 FP header from 
AMD ® X570 PCH 
Supports transfer speeds up to 5Gb/s 
Backwards-compatible USB 2.0 and USB 1.1 support 
 USB 3.2 Gen.2 Ports: 
2x from AMD ® X570 PCH – 2x external (Type-A), 1x internal header 
Supports transfer speeds up to 10Gb/s 
Backwards-compatible USB 3.2 Gen.1, USB 2.0 and USB 1.1 support 
 Display Outputs: 
Display Port 1.4 / HDMI 2.0 
 SATA Ports: 
8x SATA 6Gb/s data transfer rate / AMD X570 PCH 
- Support for RAID0, RAID1, and RAID10 and hot plug 
 Onboard LAN: 
Intel ® 211AT Gigabit NIC | Intel ® Dual-Band Wi-Fi / BT 
 Onboard Audio: 
Realtek ALC1220 HD Audio 7.1 Channel/Optical Out + EVGA NU Audio 

 Power Functions: 
Supports ACPI (Advanced Configuration and Power Interface) 
Supports S0 (normal), S3 (suspend to RAM), S4 (Suspend to disk - depends 
on OS), and S5 (soft - off) 
 PCI-Express Expansion Slots: 
2x PCIe Gen4* x16 slots (via CPU) 
1x PCIe Gen4 x4 slot (via X570 chipset) 
 PCIe 4.0* Support: 
Low power consumption and power management features 
 SLI and Crossfire Support: 
NVIDIA ® SLI ® Ready, AMD Multi-GPU Support for DX12 
 Additional Expansion Slots: 
1x M.2 Key-M 110mm Gen4 slot (via CPU)** 
1x M.2 Key-M 110mm Gen4 slot (via Chipset) 
1x M.2 Key-E 32mm slot 
 Single PS/2 port for keyboard and mouse 
 Pump Header: 
1x Pump Header (3A) 
 Fan Headers: 
2x 4-pin PWM controlled headers / 5x 4-pin PWM/DC controlled headers 

ALL FAN HEADERS HAVE A MAXIMUM POWER LIMIT OF 2 AMP @ 12 VOLTS (24 WATTS). EXCEEDING THIS LIMIT WILL CAUSE IRREPARABLE DAMAGE TO THE BOARD.
